headline: Investment firm Sopris Capital has bought Blackford Analysis, a software company that helps hospitals run many AI imaging tools, from Bayer.
score_reason: Confirmed ownership change in medical imaging AI, but price and effect on hospitals are not given.
importance_line: Hospital radiology departments using Blackford's platform and the AI vendors listed on it are affected, but the release gives no price and says no disruption is planned, so the practical effect is unproven.
summary: Sopris Capital says in a press release that it has completed the purchase of Blackford Analysis from Bayer; AuntMinnie and PE Hub also report the deal. Blackford's platform lets hospitals run more than 130 imaging AI applications from over 45 vendors in one place, and Sopris plans to combine it with its portfolio company Azra AI in the coming days or weeks, without disrupting current customers.
notes: Text read via the Yahoo Finance UK copy of the paid PR Newswire release; the link is the original release URL named there. AuntMinnie (pool link) was blocked (403). Deal terms not disclosed.
